newsitem.title: USA: Cable sector dominates U.S. corporate bond market.
newsitem.headline: Cable sector dominates U.S. corporate bond market.

text.p: Activity in the U.S. corporate bond market focused primarily on the cable sector in an otherwise quite morning of trade Thursday, traders said.
Market players were eagerly anticipating a investor conference call being held by TCI Communications at 1445 EST/1945 GMT to discuss the company's third-quarter earnings which were released Thursday.
Traders said there was little trading on the TCI bonds following the company's announement earlier of a third-quarter loss of $0.75 per share versus $0.26 at the same time last year.
Traders said U.K. cable bonds were up 1/4 across the board as a result of the renewed focus on consolidation in the sector.
In other areas of the junk market, traders said Trump Castle bonds were up two points on anticipation of an imminent announcement by Rank Organization Plc about the status of its talks with Trump.
Rank is currently negotiating with Trump to transform Trump Castle in Atlantic City into a Hard Rock Cafe & Casino.
"Everyone is hanging on the TCI news because they are on watch for a downgrade by (Standard & Poor's)." said a cable analyst.
Seperately, activity was also brisk among high-yield U.K. cable sector bonds as a result of fresh round of merger and acquisition-related speculation by market players.
Rumors circulated about the possible merger of TeleWest Communications and Comcast UK Cable.
Market sources say the rumors were fueled by comments made by Comcast management Wednesday that the company is exploring strategic options which may include a merger.
